name: 54303 · Green Bay, WI
findings: ZIP 54303 (Green Bay) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54303 (Green Bay) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54303 (Green Bay) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
